verses.arabicText: حمٓ
verses.transliteration: Hha-meem
verses.translation: Ḥâ-Mĩm

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.transliteration: Wal-kitābi l-mubīn
verses.translation: By the clear Book

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyal-laʿallakum taʿqilūn
verses.translation: Certainly, We have made it a Quran in Arabic so perhaps you will understand

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innahu fī ummi l-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīmun
verses.translation: And indeed, it is—in the Master Record with Us—highly esteemed, rich in wisdom

verses.arabicText: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Afanaḍribu ʿankumu dh-dhik'ra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawmam-mus'rifīn
verses.translation: Should We then turn the ˹Quranic˺ Reminder away from you ˹simply˺ because you have been a transgressing people

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّۢ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wakam arsalnā min-nabiyyin fī l-awalīn
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many prophets We sent to those ˹destroyed˺ before

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā yatīhim min-nabiyyin illā kānū bihi yastahziūn
verses.translation: But no prophet ever came to them without being mocked

verses.arabicText: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ahlaknā ashadda min'hum baṭshaw-wamaḍā mathalu l-awalīn
verses.translation: So We destroyed those who were far mightier than these ˹Meccans˺. The examples of ˹their˺ predecessors have ˹already˺ been related

verses.arabicText: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa s-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdaw-wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulal-laʿallakum tahtadūn
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for you, and set in it pathways for you so that you may find your way

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhī nazzala mina s-samāi māan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldatam-maytan kadhālika tukh'rajūn
verses.translation: And ˹He is the One˺ Who sends down rain from the sky in perfect measure, with which We give life to a lifeless land. And so will you be brought forth ˹from the grave˺

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mina l-ful'ki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūn
verses.translation: And ˹He is the One˺ Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs, and made for you ships and animals to ride

verses.arabicText: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurū niʿ'mata rabbikum idhā is'tawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū sub'ḥāna alladhī sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muq'rinīn
verses.translation: so that you may sit firmly on their backs, and remember your Lord’s blessings once you are settled on them, saying, “Glory be to the One Who has subjected these for us, for we could have never done so ˹on our own˺

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn
verses.translation: And surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return.”

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalū lahu min ʿibādihi juz'an inna l-insāna lakafūrum-mubīnun
verses.translation: Still the pagans have made some of His creation out to be a part of Him. Indeed, humankind is clearly ungrateful

verses.arabicText: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ami ittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātiw-wa-aṣfākum bil-banīn
verses.translation: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons

verses.arabicText: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddaw-wahuwa kaẓīmun
verses.translation: Whenever one of them is given the good news of what they attribute to the Most Compassionate, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage

verses.arabicText: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Awamay-yunasha-u fī l-ḥil'yati wahuwa fī l-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīnin
verses.translation: ˹Do they attribute to Him˺ those who are brought up in fineries and are not commanding in disputes

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalū l-malāikata alladhīna hum ʿibādu r-raḥmāni ināthan ashahidū khalqahum satuk'tabu shahādatuhum wayus'alūn
verses.translation: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū law shāa r-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum mā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yakhruṣūn
verses.translation: And they argue, “Had the Most Compassionate willed, we would have never worshipped them.” They have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They do nothing but lie

verses.arabicText: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am ātaynāhum kitābam-min qablihi fahum bihi mus'tamsikūn
verses.translation: Or have We given them a Book ˹for proof˺, before this ˹Quran˺, to which they are holding firm

verses.arabicText: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatiw-wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muh'tadūn
verses.translation: In fact, they say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are following in their footsteps.”

verses.arabicText: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatim-min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatiw-wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muq'tadūn
verses.translation: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you ˹O Prophet˺, its ˹spoiled˺ elite would say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are walking in their footsteps.”

verses.arabicText: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāakum qālū innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūn
verses.translation: Each ˹warner˺ asked, “Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?” They replied, “We totally reject whatever you have been sent with.”

verses.arabicText: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīn
verses.translation: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of the deniers

verses.arabicText: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi waqawmihi innanī barāom-mimmā taʿbudūn
verses.translation: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when Abraham declared to his father and his people, “I am totally free of whatever ˹gods˺ you worship

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.transliteration: Illā alladhī faṭaranī fa-innahu sayahdīn
verses.translation: except the One Who originated me, and He will surely guide me.”

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wajaʿalahā kalimatan bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.translation: And he left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may ˹always˺ turn back ˹to Allah˺

verses.arabicText: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Bal mattaʿtu hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā jāahumu l-ḥaqu warasūlum-mubīnun
verses.translation: In fact, I had allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers, until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear

verses.arabicText: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu qālū hādhā siḥ'ruw-wa-innā bihi kāfirūn
verses.translation: ˹But˺ when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally reject it.”

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhā l-qur'ānu ʿalā rajulim-mina l-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmin
verses.translation: And they exclaimed, “If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from ˹one of˺ the two cities!”

verses.arabicText: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fī l-ḥayati d-dun'yā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātil-liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukh'riyyaw-waraḥmatu rabbika khayrum-mimmā yajmaʿūn
verses.translation: Is it they who distribute your Lord’s mercy? We ˹alone˺ have distributed their ˹very˺ livelihood among them in this worldly life and raised some of them in rank above others so that some may employ others in service. ˹But˺ your Lord’s mercy is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walawlā ay-yakūna n-nāsu ummataw-wāḥidatan lajaʿalnā limay-yakfuru bil-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufam-min fiḍḍatiw-wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūn
verses.translation: Were it not that people might ˹be tempted to˺ become one community ˹of disbelievers˺, We would have supplied the homes of ˹only˺ those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate with silver roofs and ˹silver˺ stairways to ascend

verses.arabicText: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.transliteration: Walibuyūtihim abwābaw-wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiūn
verses.translation: as well as ˹silver˺ gates and thrones to recline on

verses.arabicText: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wazukh'rufaw-wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu l-ḥayati d-dun'yā wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil'muttaqīn
verses.translation: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺

verses.arabicText: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًۭا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wamay-yaʿshu ʿan dhik'ri r-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnun
verses.translation: And whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Most Compassionate, We place at the disposal of each a devilish one as their close associate

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani s-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūn
verses.translation: who will certainly hinder them from the ˹Right˺ Way while they think they are ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.arabicText: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
verses.transliteration: Ḥattā idhā jāanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿ'da l-mashriqayni fabi'sa l-qarīn
verses.translation: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say ˹to their associate˺, “I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate ˹you were˺!”

verses.arabicText: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walay-yanfaʿakumu l-yawma idh ẓalamtum annakum fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūn
verses.translation: ˹It will be said to both,˺ “Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day.”

verses.arabicText: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Afa-anta tus'miʿu ṣ-ṣuma aw tahdī l-ʿum'ya waman kāna fī ḍalālim-mubīnin
verses.translation: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray

verses.arabicText: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā min'hum muntaqimūn
verses.translation: Even if We take you away ˹from this world˺, We will surely inflict punishment upon them

verses.arabicText: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Aw nuriyannaka alladhī waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim muq'tadirūn
verses.translation: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them

verses.arabicText: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fa-is'tamsik bi-alladhī ūḥiya ilayka innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭim-mus'taqīmin
verses.translation: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺. You are truly on the Straight Path

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌۭ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innahu ladhik'rul-laka waliqawmika wasawfa tus'alūn
verses.translation: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a glory for you and your people. And you will ˹all˺ be questioned ˹about it˺

verses.arabicText: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wasal man arsalnā min qablika mir-rusulinā ajaʿalnā min dūni r-raḥmāni ālihatay-yuʿ'badūn
verses.translation: Ask ˹the followers of˺ the messengers that We already sent before you if We ˹ever˺ appointed ˹other˺ gods to be worshipped besides the Most Compassionate

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faqāla innī rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīn
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā jāahum biāyātinā idhā hum min'hā yaḍḥakūn
verses.translation: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them

verses.arabicText: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukh'tihā wa-akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūn
verses.translation: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before. Ultimately, We seized them with torments so that they might return ˹to the Right Path˺

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū yāayyuha s-sāḥiru ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka innanā lamuh'tadūn
verses.translation: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūn
verses.translation: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise

verses.arabicText: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wanādā fir'ʿawnu fī qawmihi qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mul'ku miṣ'ra wahādhihi l-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī afalā tub'ṣirūn
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting, “O my people! Am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as ˹all˺ these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see

verses.arabicText: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌۭ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
verses.transliteration: Am anā khayrum-min hādhā alladhī huwa mahīnuw-walā yakādu yubīn
verses.translation: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself

verses.arabicText: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌۭ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falawlā ul'qiya ʿalayhi aswiratum-min dhahabin aw jāa maʿahu l-malāikatu muq'tarinīn
verses.translation: Why then have no golden bracelets ˹of kingship˺ been granted to him or angels come with him as escorts!”

verses.arabicText: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-is'takhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn
verses.translation: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā āsafūnā intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all

verses.arabicText: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًۭا وَمَثَلًۭا لِّلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fajaʿalnāhum salafaw-wamathalan lil'ākhirīn
verses.translation: And We made them an example and a lesson for those after them

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
verses.transliteration: Walammā ḍuriba ub'nu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka min'hu yaṣiddūn
verses.translation: When the son of Mary was cited as an example ˹in argument˺, your people ˹O Prophet˺ broke into ˹joyful˺ applause

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū aālihatunā khayrun am huwa mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalan bal hum qawmun khaṣimūn
verses.translation: They exclaimed, “Which is better: our gods or Jesus?” They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalal-libanī is'rāīl
verses.translation: He was only a servant We showed favour to, and made as an example for the Children of Israel

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walaw nashāu lajaʿalnā minkum malāikatan fī l-arḍi yakhlufūn
verses.translation: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you ˹all˺ with angels, succeeding one another on earth

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innahu laʿil'mul-lilssāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wa-ittabiʿūni hādhā ṣirāṭum-mus'taqīmun
verses.translation: And his ˹second˺ coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path

verses.arabicText: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Walā yaṣuddannakumu sh-shayṭānu innahu lakum ʿaduwwum-mubīnun
verses.translation: And do not let Satan hinder you, ˹for˺ he is certainly your sworn enemy

verses.arabicText: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.transliteration: Walammā jāa ʿīsā bil-bayināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥik'mati wali-ubayyina lakum baʿḍa alladhī takhtalifūna fīhi fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūn
verses.translation: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-laha huwa rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭum-mus'taqīmun
verses.translation: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”

verses.arabicText: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylul-lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīmin
verses.translation: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day

verses.arabicText: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hal yanẓurūna illā s-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtataw-wahum lā yashʿurūn
verses.translation: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺

verses.arabicText: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Al-akhilāu yawma-idhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illā l-mutaqīn
verses.translation: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous

verses.arabicText: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu l-yawma walā antum taḥzanūn
verses.translation: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Alladhīna āmanū biāyātinā wakānū mus'limīn
verses.translation: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺

verses.arabicText: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Ud'khulū l-janata antum wa-azwājukum tuḥ'barūn
verses.translation: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”

verses.arabicText: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfim-min dhahabiw-wa-akwābin wafīhā mā tashtahīhi l-anfusu wataladhu l-aʿyunu wa-antum fīhā khālidūn
verses.translation: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever

verses.arabicText: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Watil'ka l-janatu allatī ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūn
verses.translation: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do

verses.arabicText: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratum-min'hā takulūn
verses.translation: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna l-muj'rimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūn
verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever

verses.arabicText: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.transliteration: Lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mub'lisūn
verses.translation: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair

verses.arabicText: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū humu ẓ-ẓālimīn
verses.translation: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers

verses.arabicText: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wanādaw yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuka qāla innakum mākithūn
verses.translation: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”

verses.arabicText: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
verses.transliteration: Laqad ji'nākum bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharakum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūn
verses.translation: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth

verses.arabicText: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am abramū amran fa-innā mub'rimūn
verses.translation: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning

verses.arabicText: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūn
verses.translation: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qul in kāna lilrraḥmāni waladun fa-anā awwalu l-ʿābidīn
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”

verses.arabicText: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.transliteration: Sub'ḥāna rabbi s-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūn
verses.translation: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim

verses.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūn
verses.translation: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of

verses.arabicText: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Wahuwa alladhī fī s-samāi ilāhuw-wafī l-arḍi ilāhuw-wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīm
verses.translation: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing

verses.arabicText: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Watabāraka alladhī lahu mul'ku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā waʿindahu ʿil'mu s-sāʿati wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūn
verses.translation: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.arabicText: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Walā yamliku alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi sh-shafāʿata illā man shahida bil-ḥaqi wahum yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly

verses.arabicText: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūn
verses.translation: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺

verses.arabicText: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Waqīlihi yārabbi inna hāulāi qawmul-lā yu'minūn
verses.translation: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'faḥ ʿanhum waqul salāmun fasawfa yaʿlamūn
verses.translation: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know
